_comment: Motion tokens (ADR 0005): the 3D UI's springs and fades, read by both platforms so both move the same way. The apps load this file at runtime (Motion.swift, Motion.kt), and tools/generate-data.py also generates it into Tuning.Motion in SmashCore and :core. Springs are integrated in fixed 1/240 s substeps with semi-implicit Euler: a = -stiffness*(x - target) - damping*v. Spring values are unitless (a component maps 0..1 onto its own pose); kicks are velocities in those units per second.

soft._use: things leaving: hop, spin and fall away

snappy._use: flip cards: a fast turn with a small clack past the stop

wobbly._use: celebration jelly: rings for about a second

swoop._use: the camera between screens, about a second
